title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Anna went on a trip to the mountains. She took a small bag and a map. On the first day, she walked up a long path to a lake.

At the top of the path, she met a guide named Tom. He showed her the way back to the village. Anna was tired, but she was very happy with her adventure.

questions.text: Where did Anna go last summer?
Who did Anna meet at the top of the path?
How did Anna probably feel at the end of the trip?
Why did Anna probably need a guide?
options: She wanted to buy a map
She needed help finding the way back
She wanted to swim in the lake
She was looking for her bag

vocabulary.definition: a person who shows people the way
a small group of houses in the countryside

paragraph_translations: Zeszłego lata Anna pojechała na wycieczkę w góry. Wzięła mały plecak i mapę. Pierwszego dnia szła długą ścieżką do jeziora.
Na szczycie ścieżki Anna spotkała przewodnika o imieniu Tom. Pokazał jej drogę powrotną do wioski. Anna była zmęczona, ale bardzo szczęśliwa ze swojej przygody.
